controls.negative: Probe against patched/app.py exits 1 (marker NOT observed).

description: Northwind Pantry is a small storefront whose /search endpoint builds its SQLite query by string interpolation. A hidden QA prototype product is flagged invisible (visible=0), so it never appears in storefront results, but a SQL injection in the q parameter comments out the visibility filter and returns every row, exposing the hidden product and its marker. The patched variant binds q as a query parameter.

expected_finding.evidence: Probe injects a tautology payload (' OR '1'='1') -- ) into /find?q= and observes the hidden product row (marker FNDRY-SQLI-7Q2X9) in the results, a row no ordinary search term can return.

title: SQL injection in product search
